newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan allows additional Fedex stop in Naha.
newsitem.headline: Japan allows additional Fedex stop in Naha.

text.p: Japan has agreed to an expansion of U.S. air cargo carrier Federal Express Corp's routes to include a stop at Naha, the capital of Okinawa, Japan's southernmost island, a Transport Ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.
The agreement allows Federal Express to pick up cargo at Naha and fly on to Asian cities such as Singapore, Seoul and Manila.
Cargo loaded in Tokyo can be flown to Singapore and Seoul -- routes covered by existing agreements -- but not to Manila, which is not covered by the agreement.
